modules.apiContract: validate_id(raw,profile); rescale(i64,sourceScale,targetScale,rounding); canonical_digest(typeId,version,fields). Result is a typed value or InvalidId/UnitMismatch/Overflow/UnsupportedProfile, never a grant.

modules.algorithmAndBounds: Checked i128 product, Euclidean magnitude quotient/remainder, restore sign; nearest ties go to even magnitude. Digest variable fields with explicit domain and length. Never quantize authority/fence/deletion fields.
modules.acceptanceOracle: +2.5->2,+3.5->4,-2.5->-2,-3.5->-4; overflow rejects; equal numeric ppm/Q24 values retain different source digests. Cross-language golden bytes must match.

remainingWork: Admit production numeric profiles and verify actual consumer/wire compatibility; numerical equivalence alone does not establish byte compatibility.

remainingWork: The target negotiate operation is not implemented by this fixed-version codec; transport negotiation and production schema admission need their owning integration.

modules.algorithmAndBounds: Authenticate, compare every bound field, check current epoch/expiry, consume once, enter adapter. A reflex payload change invalidates the token and requires a new final binding or veto. Fail closed when revocation state is unavailable.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Race entry/revoke under a controlled schedule: post-revoke entries deny; earlier entered operations remain tracked and cancellation is best-effort. Changed destination/digest denies; restoring an older DB cannot revive the lease.
